sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她曾被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽了千方百计来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是档案档案呈献的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 请查看您应用上或我们网站上本集的节目说明。

sentences.en: At approximately 11.45pm on Monday, April 24, 1995,
sentences.zh: 1995年4月24日星期一晚上11点45分左右，

sentences.en: Constable Robert Cross was manning the public information desk at the Ottawa Carlton Regional Police Headquarters when he saw a man approaching.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·克罗斯警员正在渥太华卡尔顿地区警察总部的信息台值班，这时他看到一个男人走了过来。

sentences.en: The man was in his mid-40s with bald-in grey hair and a bushy moustache.
sentences.zh: 这个男人四十岁出头，灰白头发秃顶，留着浓密的胡子。

sentences.en: When the man reached Constable Cross's desk, he informed the officer that he wished to report a missing person
sentences.zh: 当这名男子走到克罗斯警员的桌前时，他告诉警员他想报警失踪人员

sentences.en: The man's name was Brett Morgan He was worried about his partner, 46-year-old Louise Ellis
sentences.zh: 这名男子的名字叫布雷特·摩根，他很担心自己的伴侣、46岁的露易丝·埃利斯

sentences.en: Brett had last seen Louise more than 48 hours earlier when she'd left to visit an old friend at around 2pm on Saturday April 22
sentences.zh: 布雷特最后一次见到露易丝是在48个多小时前，当时她在大约4月22日星期六下午2点左右离开去拜访一位老朋友

sentences.en: The friend lived in a cottage near Wakefield in the Gatineau Hills
sentences.zh: 这位朋友住在加蒂诺山韦克菲尔德附近的一座小屋里

sentences.en: A forested area in the neighbouring province of Quebec
sentences.zh: 邻省魁北克的森林地区

sentences.en: It was only a 30 minute or so drive from Ottawa And Louise planned to stay there one or two nights
sentences.zh: 从渥太华开车只需30分钟左右，露易丝计划在那里住上一两晚

sentences.en: Brett Morgan said she had been cheerful and excited about her weekend retreat
sentences.zh: 布雷特·摩根说，她对周末的隐居生活感到高兴和兴奋

sentences.en: But the following day, Brett received a phone call from Louise's friend
sentences.zh: 但第二天，布雷特接到了露易丝朋友的电话

sentences.en: Saying that she'd never arrived
sentences.zh: 说她从来没有到过那里

sentences.en: Brett wasn't overly concerned as Louise had mentioned she might visit another friend in the area as well and spend a night with her.
sentences.zh: 布雷特并没有过分担心，因为露易丝曾提到她可能也会去该地区的另一个朋友家拜访，并在她那里过夜。

sentences.en: Perhaps she had decided to go there firSt.
sentences.zh: 也许她决定先去那里。

sentences.en: But when there was no sign of Louise by Monday evening, Brett began to raise the alarm.
sentences.zh: 但到了周一晚上仍不见露易丝的踪影，布雷特开始拉响警报。

sentences.en: He called a number of Louise's friends asking if anyone had seen her.
sentences.zh: 他给露易丝的许多朋友打电话，询问是否有人见过她。

sentences.en: Nobody had.
sentences.zh: 没有人。

sentences.en: One person Brett called was Brenda Misson, the second friend Louise had planned to visit while away.
sentences.zh: 布雷特打电话的人之一是布伦达·米森，这是露易丝外出时计划拜访的第二个朋友。

sentences.en: Brenda hadn't seen Louise, but Brett's call jogged a memory.
sentences.zh: 布伦达没有见过露易丝，但布雷特的电话唤醒了记忆。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, Brenda had been driving along a rural stretch near her home in Wakefield, Quebec, when she saw a yellow and
sentences.zh: 那天早些时候，布伦达正开车行驶在她位于魁北克韦克菲尔德的家附近的一条乡村公路上，当时她看到了一辆黄色的

sentences.en: white Suzuki sidekick Jeep parked on the shoulder of the road.
sentences.zh: 白色铃木吉普车停在路肩上。

sentences.en: It was the same make and model as
sentences.zh: 这是相同的品牌和型号

sentences.en: Louise's car.
sentences.zh: 露易丝的车。

sentences.en: Brenda made a mental note to check whether it belonged to her friend later on.
sentences.zh: 布伦达记在心里，稍后检查这是否属于她的朋友。

sentences.en: She had forgotten to do so until Brett's call reminded her.
sentences.zh: 直到布雷特的电话提醒她，她才忘记了这一点。

sentences.en: Brett rushed to meet Brenda and they inspected the car together.
sentences.zh: 布雷特冲去见布伦达，两人一起检查了这辆车。

sentences.en: The license plates confirmed it was Louise's car.
sentences.zh: 车牌证实这是露易丝的车。

sentences.en: Its doors were locked.
sentences.zh: 车门是锁着的。

sentences.en: Inside in the back of the vehicle was a wrapped gift Louise had been taking for her friend's daughter as well as
sentences.zh: 车内后座上放着一件露易丝要带给她朋友女儿的包好的礼物，还有

sentences.en: Louise's overnight bag.
sentences.zh: 露易丝的过夜包。

sentences.en: Her handbag lay on the front passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 她的手提包放在前排乘客座位上。

sentences.en: Her wallet was inside along with some cash and all her bank cards.
sentences.zh: 她的钱包在里面，还有一些现金和她所有的银行卡。

sentences.en: There was no sign of Louise.
sentences.zh: 没有露易丝的踪迹。

sentences.en: Brett appeared calm as he relayed his story to Constable Robert Cross but the officer could hear the worry and concern in his voice.
sentences.zh: 布雷特向罗伯特·克罗斯警员讲述自己的故事时显得很平静，但警员能从他的声音中听出担忧和关切。

sentences.en: The pair spoke for roughly 30 minutes while Constable Cross filled out the missing persons report with all the details Brett provided.
sentences.zh: 两人交谈了大约30分钟，同时克罗斯警员根据布雷特提供的所有细节填写了失踪人员报告。

sentences.en: During their conversation, Brett suddenly said something unexpected.
sentences.zh: 在交谈过程中，布雷特突然说了一些出乎意料的话。

sentences.en: He informed the constable that he had previously been convicted of killing a woman.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警员，他以前曾被判犯有谋杀一名女性罪。

sentences.en: Constable Robert Cross was surprised and disturbed by this revelation.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·克罗斯警员对这一启示感到惊讶和不安。

sentences.en: Brett Morgan came across as a loving and caring spouse who was genuinely concerned about his missing partner's
sentences.zh: 布雷特·摩根给人的印象是一个充满爱心和关怀的配偶，他真正关心失踪的伴侣

sentences.en: welfare, so his admission that he had previously served time for killing another woman was shocking.
sentences.zh: 福利，所以他承认自己曾因杀害另一名女性而服刑，这令人震惊。

sentences.en: Brett explained that his previous conviction was a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 布雷特解释说，他以前的定罪是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: 17 years earlier, when he was in his late 20s, he had gotten mixed up in criminal activity, including break-and-enters and theft.
sentences.zh: 17年前，当他二十多岁快结束时，他卷入了犯罪活动，包括入室盗窃和盗窃。

sentences.en: One night during this period, Brett had been consuming drugs and alcohol with his then-girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 在这期间的一个晚上，布雷特一直在和当时的男友一起吸毒和喝酒。

sentences.en: At around 2.30 in the morning, he got into an argument with a woman named Gwen Telford, who'd lived in shared accommodation with them.
sentences.zh: 凌晨2点半左右，他与一名叫格温·特尔福德的女子发生争执，这名女子与他们合租房子。

sentences.en: Gwen was 21 and an accomplice to Brett's crimes.
sentences.zh: 格温21岁，是布雷特犯罪的同谋。

sentences.en: Brett had strangled Gwen and was subsequently convicted of manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 布雷特勒死了格温，随后被判过失杀人罪。

sentences.en: He served 10 years, but following his release he was convicted of new charges relating to fraud, theft, forgery and escaping custody.
sentences.zh: 他服刑10年，但在获释后，他又因诈骗、盗窃、伪造和脱逃等新罪名被定罪。

sentences.en: Constable Cross found Brett to be remarkably upfront about his criminal past, especially given the nature of his visit.
sentences.zh: 克罗斯警员发现布雷特对自己的犯罪过去非常坦率，考虑到他来访的性质，更是如此。

sentences.en: His frank admission and willingness to honestly cooperate was totally at odds with what the officer would have expected for an individual with his history and a newly missing partner.
sentences.zh: 他坦率的供认和诚实合作的意愿，与警员对一个有这样历史且伴侣新近失踪的人的预期完全不符。

sentences.en: Constable Cross informed Brett that if Louise had been harmed in some way
sentences.zh: 克罗斯警员告诉布雷特，如果露易丝以某种方式受到伤害

sentences.en: Brett's record meant that he would naturally be a suspect
sentences.zh: 布雷特的记录意味着他自然会成为嫌疑人

sentences.en: Brett replied that he understood that and expected that
sentences.zh: 布雷特回答说他理解这一点并预料到了这一点

sentences.en: But he was adamant that he hadn't hurt Louise
sentences.zh: 但他坚称自己没有伤害露易丝

sentences.en: She was someone he described as his soulmate and the person who had hoped to turn his life around
sentences.zh: 她被他描述为他的灵魂伴侣，也是希望改变他生活的人

sentences.en: They had met three years earlier in March 1992 while Brett was serving his second sentence
sentences.zh: 他们于三年前的1992年3月相遇，当时布雷特正在服第二次刑

sentences.en: Louise was attending a Supreme Court hearing into the wrongful conviction of a man for murder She was a freelance writer and hoped to write a book about the case
sentences.zh: 露易丝正在出席最高法院关于一名男子被错误谋杀罪定罪的听证会。她是一名自由撰稿人，希望写一本关于此案的书

sentences.en: As Louise sat in the public gallery, Brett Morgan was brought in shackled to testify as a witness
sentences.zh: 正当露易丝坐在公众席上时，戴着手铐出庭作证的布雷特·摩根被带了进来

sentences.en: A former cellmate of his had admitted to being the true perpetrator of the crime and Brett had come forward to testify
sentences.zh: 他的一位前狱友承认自己是真正的罪魁祸首，布雷特挺身而出作证

sentences.en: Louise, who was a fierce justice advocate, was struck by Brett's courage
sentences.zh: 露易丝是一名坚定的正义倡导者，她被布雷特的勇气所打动

sentences.en: His actions wouldn't make him popular with his fellow inmates
sentences.zh: 他的行为不会让他受到狱友的欢迎

sentences.en: After Brett finished testifying, he was escorted back out of the courtroom
sentences.zh: 布雷特作证结束后，被护送出法庭

sentences.en: Louise followed him to the elevator where he was flanked by two guards
sentences.zh: 露易丝跟着他来到电梯旁，两名警卫夹在两旁

sentences.en: She tapped one of the guards on his elbow and said,
sentences.zh: 她拍了拍其中一名警卫的胳膊肘，说道：

sentences.en: I'd like to have a word with Brett.
sentences.zh: 我想和布雷特谈谈。

sentences.en: She then made eye contact with Brett and told him,
sentences.zh: 然后她看着布雷特的眼睛告诉他：

sentences.en: I think what you did was really brave.
sentences.zh: 我认为你所做的是非常勇敢的。

sentences.en: Brett smiled and thanked her.
sentences.zh: 布雷特笑了笑并向她表示感谢。

sentences.en: Louise subsequently wrote a letter to Brett and they struck up a friendship, then a romantic relationship while he served out his sentence.
sentences.zh: 此后，露易丝给布雷特写了一封信，他们建立起了友谊，并在他服刑期间发展成为恋爱关系。

sentences.en: They communicated via letters, phone calls and eventually had in-person visits In 1994, Louise helped Brett with his parole application
sentences.zh: 他们通过信件、电话进行交流，最终进行了面谈。1994年，露易丝帮助布雷特申请假释

sentences.en: Hiring lawyers for him and staying in constant contact via the telephone
sentences.zh: 为他聘请律师并通过电话保持联系

sentences.en: Her efforts paid off and in May 1994, Brett Morgan left prison on parole
sentences.zh: 她的努力得到了回报，1994年5月，布雷特·摩根假释出狱

sentences.en: Louise was there to pick him up in her yellow Suzuki sidekick and she bought him an ice cream cake to celebrate on the way home.
sentences.zh: 露易丝开着她的黄色铃木吉普车去接他，并在回家的路上给他买了一个冰淇淋蛋糕来庆祝。

sentences.en: Brett moved in with her and she had helped him establish a home renovation business.
sentences.zh: 布雷特搬去和她一起住，她帮助他建立了一家房屋装修企业。

sentences.en: They had been a happy couple who were often observed by a neighbour sitting on the front porch together holding hands.
sentences.zh: 他们是一对幸福的夫妇，邻居经常看到他们一起坐在前廊上手拉着手。

sentences.en: Although Constable Cross saw nothing in Brett Morgan's demeanour that made him suspicious, Brett's background meant he couldn't be treated like an ordinary citizen.
sentences.zh: 虽然克罗斯警员在布雷特·摩根的举止中没有发现任何让他起疑的地方，但布雷特的背景意味着他不能像普通公民那样对待。

sentences.en: Constable Cross asked Brett if he would accompany him to the criminal investigation department to speak with detectives.
sentences.zh: 克罗斯警员问布雷特是否愿意陪他去刑事调查部门与侦探谈话。

sentences.en: Brett agreed.
sentences.zh: 布雷特同意了。

sentences.en: He repeated his story to two detectives who listened attentively and took notes.
sentences.zh: 他向两位专心倾听并做笔记的侦探重复了他的故事。

sentences.en: They asked Brett to come back to the station the following day with photographs of Louise for a missing persons poster.
sentences.zh: 他们要求布雷特第二天带着露易丝的照片回到警察局，制作一张失踪人员海报。

sentences.en: Brett Morgan returned to the police station the following morning, accompanied by a friend of his and Louise.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，布雷特·摩根在一位朋友和露易丝的陪同下返回警察局。

sentences.en: Detectives wanted to interview Brett again.
sentences.zh: 侦探们想再次讯问布雷特。

sentences.en: Although he seemed anxious to get on with searching for his partner, Brett obliged.
sentences.zh: 尽管他似乎急于继续寻找他的伴侣，但布雷特还是照办了。

sentences.en: After the 90-minute interview concluded, Brett told his friends that the detectives had put quite a bit of heat on him during the interrogation, wanting to know all the details
sentences.zh: 90分钟的审讯结束后，布雷特告诉他的朋友，侦探们在审讯期间给他施加了相当大的压力，想了解所有的细节

sentences.en: of his recent movements.
sentences.zh: 他最近的动向。

sentences.en: Brett didn't seem happy about this development, but told his friend he would do whatever he had to if it helped them bind Louise.
sentences.zh: 布雷特似乎对这一进展并不高兴，但他告诉朋友，如果能帮他们找到露易丝，他会尽其所能。

sentences.en: As it stood, there was no evidence that a crime had been committed.
sentences.zh: 就目前而言，没有证据表明发生了犯罪。

sentences.en: All of the detectives who spoke to Brett Morgan found him to be a calm, polite and cooperative witness, as well as a clearly worried spouse.
sentences.zh: 所有与布雷特·摩根交谈过的侦探都发现他是一个冷静、礼貌、合作的证人，也是一个明显担心的配偶。

sentences.en: Brett's parole officer reported to detectives that Brett was doing well on parole and there seemed to be no problems between him and Louise.
sentences.zh: 布雷特的假释官向侦探报告说，布雷特假释期间表现良好，他和露易丝之间似乎没有问题。

sentences.en: Detectives asked Brett if they could see Louise's will and he obligingly showed it to them.
sentences.zh: 侦探问布雷特是否可以看露易丝的遗嘱，他欣然出示了。

sentences.en: It turned out that he was Louise's sole beneficiary, but by law he would receive nothing for seven years unless she was confirmed to be deceased.
sentences.zh: 事实证明他是露易丝唯一的受益人，但根据法律规定，除非确认她已经死亡，否则他在七年内什么也得不到。

sentences.en: Brett also handed over Louise's financial records and her private diaries.
sentences.zh: 布雷特还交出了露易丝的财务记录和私人日记。

sentences.en: The following day of Wednesday April 26, a search party assembled outside a restaurant in the town of Wakefield, Quebec, close to where
sentences.zh: 第二天，即4月26日星期三，搜救队在魁北克韦克菲尔德镇的一家餐馆外集合，该餐馆靠近

sentences.en: Louise's car had been found.
sentences.zh: 露易丝的车被找到了。

sentences.en: As well as Ottawa detectives and local police officers from Quebec,
sentences.zh: 除了渥太华侦探和魁北克当地警官外，

sentences.en: Brett Morgan and members of Louise's family were present.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·摩根和露易丝的家人也在场。

sentences.en: The group spanned out from the area of River Road where Louise's car was parked
sentences.zh: 搜寻人员从停有露易丝汽车的里弗路地区散开

sentences.en: There was nothing wrong with the vehicle that might have prompted Louise to abandon it there and its tank was full of petrol
sentences.zh: 这辆车没有任何毛病，可能会促使露易丝把它抛弃在那里，而且它的油箱里加满了汽油

sentences.en: A couple who lived nearby told police they'd noticed the jeep parked there since Saturday April 22 the day Louise had left for her trip
sentences.zh: 一对住在附近的夫妇告诉警察，自从4月22日星期六露易丝踏上旅程的那天起，他们就注意到这辆吉普车停在那里

sentences.en: It was towed to a nearby garage where an officer would later dust it for prints.
sentences.zh: 它被拖到附近的修理厂，随后一名警察会在那里擦拭指纹。

sentences.en: The area surrounding River Road was densely wooded and spring rain had made it muddy.
sentences.zh: 里弗路周围地区树木丛生，春雨使其变得泥泞不堪。

sentences.en: Police officers and Louise's loved ones tramped through the cold, scouring the bushes and trees for any trace of Louise.
sentences.zh: 警察和露易丝的亲人在寒风中跋涉，在灌木丛和树木中搜寻露易丝的踪迹。

sentences.en: They looked through piles of lumber and felled trees, as well as a nearby ridge that was dotted with boulders and a derelict car.
sentences.zh: 他们搜寻了成堆的木材和倒下的树木，以及附近布满巨石和一辆废弃汽车的山脊。

sentences.en: They found nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们什么也没找到。

sentences.en: Over the following days, divers would search the nearby Gatineau River, but also came up empty-handed.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，潜水员将搜寻附近的加蒂诺河，但也一无所获。

sentences.en: While the police searches were dialed down, Brett Morgan kept looking.
sentences.zh: 虽然警察的搜查力度减弱了，但布雷特·摩根仍在继续寻找。

sentences.en: He followed up leads and printed his own posters featuring a photo of Louise and requests for any witnesses to come forward.
sentences.zh: 他跟进线索并印刷了自己的海报，上面有露易丝的照片和寻找目击者站出来的请求。

sentences.en: Brett also gave interviews with the press.
sentences.zh: 布雷特还接受了媒体采访。

sentences.en: He was frank about his past, telling the Ottawa citizen, quote, I was convicted of manslaughter and it involved a woman.
sentences.zh: 他坦率地谈到了自己的过去，告诉渥太华公民报，引述说，我因过失杀人罪被定罪，涉及一名女性。

sentences.en: I understand the implications of that.
sentences.zh: 我明白其中的含义。

sentences.en: I have to be a suspect.
sentences.zh: 我必须是一个嫌疑人。

sentences.en: It's obvious.
sentences.zh: 这是显而易见的。

sentences.en: But he was adamant that he would never harm the woman who had given him a life free from crime.
sentences.zh: 但他坚称自己绝不会伤害那个给了他无犯罪生活的女人。

sentences.en: He felt lost now he was alone without her.
sentences.zh: 现在没有她陪伴，他感到自己迷失了方向。

sentences.en: On Saturday April 29, one week after Louise had gone missing, Brett spent the day standing at the site where Louise's Suzuki sidekick was found,
sentences.zh: 4月29日星期六，也就是露易丝失踪一周后，布雷特一整天都站在发现露易丝铃木吉普车的地方，

sentences.en: with a stack of his homemade posters
sentences.zh: 带着一堆他自制的的海报

sentences.en: He flagged down passing cars and told their occupants about his missing spouse in an effort to raise awareness and find potential leads
sentences.zh: 他拦下过往的汽车，向车内人员讲述他失踪的配偶，以提高认识并寻找潜在的线索

sentences.en: I can't rely on the police, he said
sentences.zh: 我不能依靠警方，他说

sentences.en: It's hard living at home, not knowing where she is
sentences.zh: 在家里的生活很艰难，不知道她在哪里

sentences.en: Police told the media that there was no evidence of any foul play, with one Ottawa detective stating,
sentences.zh: 警方对媒体表示，没有证据表明存在任何谋杀行为，一名渥太华侦探表示：

sentences.en: People go missing every day.
sentences.zh: 人们每天都在失踪。

sentences.en: She may have just gotten tired of this world and walked away.
sentences.zh: 她可能只是厌倦了这个世界并一走了之。

sentences.en: During conversations with Brett Morgan, one detective mentioned another case he'd worked on in which a woman had vanished without a trace.
sentences.zh: 在与布雷特·摩根的对话中，一名侦探提到了他处理过的另一起案件，其中一名妇女消失得无影无踪。

sentences.en: His colleagues had immediately decided her husband had murdered her, but then the woman was found alive and well, living in another city.
sentences.zh: 他的同事立即断定她丈夫谋杀了她，但随后发现该女子还活着，身体健康，住在另一个城市。

sentences.en: It turned out she'd just wanted to get away.
sentences.zh: 事实证明她只是想离开。

sentences.en: The detective said he didn't want to jump to the same conclusion again.
sentences.zh: 这名侦探表示，他不想再次得出相同的结论。

sentences.en: Investigators in Quebec were equally reluctant, telling journalists it wasn't their investigation
sentences.zh: 魁北克的调查人员同样不愿透露姓名，他们告诉记者这不是他们的调查

sentences.en: as there was nothing to indicate Louise was on their side of the border, despite her car being left there.
sentences.zh: 因为没有迹象表明露易丝在他们的国界这一侧，尽管她的车留在了那里。

sentences.en: Despite police agencies downplaying the situation, the rumour mill went into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 尽管警察机构淡化了这种情况，但流言蜚语却疯狂传播。

sentences.en: It was revealed that Louise Ellis had paid for a small ad to run in the Wanted section of a
sentences.zh: 据透露，露易丝·埃利斯曾在

sentences.en: Wakefield newspaper, which read,
sentences.zh: 韦克菲尔德报纸上刊登，上面写着：

sentences.en: Friends confirmed that Louise had spoken about wanting to lease a vacation cottage for the upcoming summer.
sentences.zh: 朋友们证实，露易丝曾谈到想在即将到来的夏天租一间度假小屋。

sentences.en: It was speculated that perhaps she had been intending to visit rental properties while in the area.
sentences.zh: 据推测，也许她打算在当地参观出租房产。

sentences.en: Others wondered if perhaps Louise had disappeared into the wilderness with the intention of taking her own life.
sentences.zh: 其他人则想知道露易丝是否带着自杀的意图消失在荒野中。

sentences.en: Rumours also spread that a stranger might have ambushed and abducted her, leaving her car behind on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 还有传言称，一个陌生人可能伏击并绑架了她，把她的车留在了路边。

sentences.en: Brett Morgan dismissed the suicide theories and kept searching, telling the media, she's my sweetheart, she wouldn't give up on me and I'm not going to give up on her.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·摩根驳斥了自杀理论并继续寻找，他告诉媒体，她是我的甜心，她不会放弃我，我也不会放弃她。

sentences.en: Brett rejected the idea that Louise had decided to abandon their life together without a word.
sentences.zh: 布雷特拒绝了露易丝决定不发一言就抛弃他们共同生活的主意。

sentences.en: He suspected foul play, but he wasn't pointing the finger at a stranger.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑有谋杀，但他没有把矛头指向陌生人。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案将很快回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本集的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: When Louise Ellis first met Brett Morgan, she was already in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 当露易丝·埃利斯第一次遇到布雷特·摩根时，她已经有了恋爱关系。

sentences.en: She had met her former partner, John May Zornweb, four years earlier at a jazz festival.
sentences.zh: 四年前，她在一次爵士乐节上结识了前任伴侣约翰·梅·佐恩韦布。

sentences.en: The pair moved in together several months after meeting, but it was a volatile on-and-off-again relationship.
sentences.zh: 两人在相识几个月后便搬到了一起，但这是一种动荡且分分合合的关系。

sentences.en: When Louise saw Brett Morgan in the courtroom and was immediately transfixed by him, it marked the end of her relationship with John Maison-Webb.
sentences.zh: 当露易丝在法庭上看到布雷特·摩根并瞬间被他吸引时，这就标志着她与约翰·梅森-韦布关系的终结。

sentences.en: He left Louise after she started speaking with Brett regularly.
sentences.zh: 在她开始频繁与布雷特交谈后，他离开了露易丝。

sentences.en: John took the breakup badly.
sentences.zh: 约翰对分手的打击很大。

sentences.en: He refused to speak to Louise and the pair lost contact for over a year.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝与露易丝说话，两人有一年多的时间失去了联系。

sentences.en: Then they started talking again in the summer of 1994, not long after Brett Morgan was released from prison and moved in with Louise.
sentences.zh: 接着，在1994年夏天，也就是布雷特·摩根刑满释放并搬去和露易丝同住不久后，他们又开始联系了。

sentences.en: There was no longer a romantic element to Louise and John's relationship, but they were able to become friends.
sentences.zh: 露易丝和约翰之间已不再有浪漫的成分，但他们能够成为朋友。

sentences.en: John had a daughter from a previous relationship and Louise was very fond of her.
sentences.zh: 约翰与前任育有一个女儿，露易丝非常喜欢她。

sentences.en: On the weekend that Louise went missing, John was the friend who she'd been planning to stay with in the Gatineau Hills.
sentences.zh: 在露易丝失踪的那个周末，约翰正是她原本计划去加蒂诺山探访并借宿的朋友。

sentences.en: It was his daughter's 12th birthday and Louise had packed a gift-wrapped book about horses for the young girl.
sentences.zh: 那天是他女儿的12岁生日，露易丝为这个小女孩打包了一本包着礼品纸的关于马的书。

sentences.en: Her car was found with this present inside, not far from John's cottage.
sentences.zh: 人们在离约翰的小木屋不远的地方发现了她的车，里面还放着这件礼物。

sentences.en: Brett Morgan told police he didn't have a problem with Louise visiting her ex for the weekend as he knew they were just friends.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·摩根告诉警方，他对露易丝在这个周末去探望前男友并不介意，因为他知道他们只是朋友。

sentences.en: When he'd received a call from John Maisonweuve the day after Louise left, saying she'd never arrived, Brett assumed she'd just decided to visit Brenda Misson instead.
sentences.zh: 在露易丝离开的第二天，当他接到约翰·梅森韦夫的电话说她一直没到时，布雷特以为她只是决定改去拜访布兰达·米森。

sentences.en: After Louise failed to return home and her car was found near John's cottage, Brett's attitude changed.
sentences.zh: 在露易丝未能回家且她的车在约翰的小木屋附近被找到之后，布雷特的态度发生了转变。

sentences.en: Detectives knew they needed to speak to John
sentences.zh: 侦探们知道他们需要找约翰谈谈

sentences.en: Maisonweff and they visited him at his workplace, the University of Ottawa.
sentences.zh: ·梅森韦夫，于是他们前往他在渥太华大学的工作地点拜访了他。

sentences.en: He said that he'd last spoken to Louise on the evening of Friday, April 21, the day before she left.
sentences.zh: 他说，他最后一次与露易丝交谈是在4月21日星期五的晚上，也就是她离开的前一天。

sentences.en: John had invited
sentences.zh: 约翰曾邀请

sentences.en: Louise to his family's cottage for dinner that night, but she had declined the invitation.
sentences.zh: 露易丝那天晚上去他家人的小木屋共进晚餐，但她拒绝了邀请。

sentences.en: John said that he hadn't been expecting Louise to visit the following day, even though Brett Morgan and one of Louise's friends were aware of this plan.
sentences.zh: 约翰称，他并没有期望露易丝第二天会来，尽管布雷特·摩根和露易丝的一位朋友都知道这个计划。

sentences.en: Moreover, John had called his ex-wife on Sunday April 23 to express his concern that Louise hadn't arrived.
sentences.zh: 此外，约翰还在4月23日星期日打电话给他的前妻，表达了他对露易丝一直未到的担忧。

sentences.en: He'd also alerted Brett Morgan.
sentences.zh: 他还提醒了布雷特·摩根。

sentences.en: John claimed that on the day Louise disappeared he'd picked up his daughter from horse riding and then spent the day with her.
sentences.zh: 约翰声称，在露易丝失踪的那天，他接女儿骑马回来，然后陪了她一整天。

sentences.en: Investigators didn't verify this alibi at the time as they felt certain it was true.
sentences.zh: 调查人员当时并未核实这个不在场证明，因为他们确信这是真的。

sentences.en: They didn't believe that anyone would implicate their young daughter if they had committed a crime.
sentences.zh: 他们不相信有人如果在犯罪的话，会把自己的亲生女儿牵扯进来。

sentences.en: However, they did take sniffer dogs to a secluded lot owned by John May Zornweb to see if they could uncover any trace of the missing woman.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们确实带着警犬去了约翰·梅·佐恩韦布名下一处偏僻的地块，看能否搜寻到这位失踪女性的任何痕迹。

sentences.en: They found nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们什么也没找到。

sentences.en: With no sign of Louise and no evidence as to her whereabouts, the case stalled.
sentences.zh: 由于毫无露易丝的踪迹，也没有她下落的证据，案件陷入了停滞。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered if she might have been targeted by an enemy of Brett Morgan's, namely the former cellmate he'd implicated in the murder of a woman.
sentences.zh: 调查人员不禁思索，她是否成了布雷特·摩根仇家的目标——也就是他曾指控涉嫌谋杀一名女性的那位前狱友。

sentences.en: The cellmate was named Larry Fisher, and at the time of Louise's disappearance he was a free man, not yet charged with the murder he was accused of.
sentences.zh: 那个狱友名叫拉里·费舍尔，在露易丝失踪时他是个自由身，尚未因被指控的谋杀罪而遭到起诉。

sentences.en: What if Larry Fisher had targeted Louise Ellis as an act of revenge against Brett Morgan for ratting him out.
sentences.zh: 如果拉里·费舍尔将露易丝·埃利斯作为报复对象，以惩罚布雷特·摩根将他供出来，那该怎么办呢。

sentences.en: Detectives looked into Fisher's whereabouts on the day in question and found that on the morning of Saturday April 22,
sentences.zh: 侦探们调查了费舍尔在事发当天的行踪，发现就在4月22日星期六的早上，

sentences.en: Fisher was the subject of a police road stop in Saskatchewan.
sentences.zh: 费舍尔在萨斯喀彻温省遭遇了一次警察设卡拦截。

sentences.en: This was roughly 3,000 kilometres away from where Louise's car was found, ruling Fisher out of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这距离发现露易丝汽车的地方大约有3000公里，从而排除了费舍尔作案的嫌疑。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, by early May, Brett Morgan had hired two private investigators to follow up on the various leads that were trickling in
sentences.zh: 与此同时，到了5月初，布雷特·摩根已经雇用了两名私家侦探，去跟进源源不断涌现的各种线索。

sentences.en: He told the Ottawa citizen that he had done so because the local police force was understaffed and unable to keep up with the investigation
sentences.zh: 他告诉《渥太华公民报》，他这样做是因为当地警局人手不足，无法跟进此案的调查。

sentences.en: When a television news reporter asked Brett how he was feeling, Brett replied
sentences.zh: 当电视台新闻记者问布雷特现在的感受时，布雷特回答说

sentences.en: Increasingly terror-filled
sentences.zh: 愈发充满恐惧

sentences.en: Marie Perrant was a businesswoman based in St-Pierre de Wakefield, Quebec.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·佩朗是一名常驻魁北克圣皮埃尔德韦克菲尔德的女商人。
zh_words: 圣皮埃尔德韦克菲尔德

sentences.en: Originally from Scotland, she had relocated to Canada in 1990 in an effort to build a relationship with her estranged father, who was French-Canadian.
sentences.zh: 她原籍苏格兰，于1990年移居加拿大，试图与她疏远的法裔加拿大父亲修复关系。

sentences.en: Once settled, she took ownership of a restaurant and a video store, but neither of these businesses were her true passion.
sentences.zh: 安顿下来后，她接手了一家餐厅和一个录像带租赁店，但这两项生意都不是她真正的热情所在。

sentences.en: Marie was more interested in detective work.
sentences.zh: 玛丽对侦探工作更感兴趣。

sentences.en: In February of 1995, she enrolled in a three-month course at the Academy of Private Investigators, with a view to maybe becoming an investigator herself one day.
sentences.zh: 1995年2月，她报名参加了私家侦探学院为期三个月的课程，希望能有朝一日自己也能成为一名调查员。

sentences.en: As the course was nearing completion, Marie heard about the disappearance of freelance writer Louise Ellis.
sentences.zh: 随着课程即将结束，玛丽听说了自由撰稿人露易丝·埃利斯失踪的消息。

sentences.en: Louise's car was found just 25 minutes away from Marie's home, and the news coverage of the event caught Marie's attention.
sentences.zh: 露易丝的车被发现的地方距离玛丽家只有25分钟的车程，对此事的报道引起了玛丽的注意。

sentences.en: Marie had a particular interest in helping women who were victims of violence and while there was no clear evidence that Louise had been attacked
sentences.zh: 玛丽对帮助遭受暴力的女性有着特殊的兴趣，虽然当时没有明确证据表明露易丝遭到过袭击，

sentences.en: it was obvious that something about the situation was wrong
sentences.zh: 但很明显，这种状况有些不对劲

sentences.en: Marie's attention was also drawn to Louise's partner, Brett Morgan She watched him appear on news updates about the case where he was visibly upset and helpless
sentences.zh: 玛丽的注意力也被露易丝的伴侣布雷特·摩根所吸引。她看着他在关于此案的新闻报道中露面，当时他显得十分心烦意乱且无助。

sentences.en: Marie's heart went out to him
sentences.zh: 玛丽打心底里同情他

sentences.en: She wondered if Louisa's disappearance could be a chance for her to practically apply the skills she learnt in her private investigator course
sentences.zh: 她琢磨着，露易丝的失踪或许正是她将私家侦探课程中所学技能付诸实践的一个机会。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, May 17, 1995, Marie Perrant called Brett Morgan's home number and left a message on his answering machine, offering to help him
sentences.zh: 1995年5月17日星期三，玛丽·佩朗拨打了布雷特·摩根家里的电话，并在他的答录机上留了言，表示愿意为他提供帮助。

sentences.en: He called her back two hours later, but explained he already had two private investigators working the case and he couldn't afford to pay a third
sentences.zh: 他两个小时后回了电话，但解释说他已经请了两位私家侦探在查这个案子，而且他无力负担第三位。

sentences.en: Marie reassured him that she didn't want any money She just wanted to help and gain some professional experience
sentences.zh: 玛丽向他保证她不要钱，她只是想帮帮忙并积累一些专业经验。

sentences.en: The pair agreed to meet and two days later
sentences.zh: 两人同意会面，两天后，

sentences.en: Marie drove over to the double storey red brick home in Old Ottawa South
sentences.zh: 玛丽开车前往位于老渥太华南区的那栋两层红砖房，

sentences.en: Where Louise and Brett lived
sentences.zh: 也就是露易丝和布雷特居住的地方。

sentences.en: Marie had brought along a tape recorder And asked Brett if he minded her taping their conversation
sentences.zh: 玛丽随身带了一台录音机，并询问布雷特介不介意她将他们的对话录下来。

sentences.en: He didn't and Marie hit record as they began to speak at the couple's kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 他不介意，于是当他们开始在夫妻俩的厨房桌旁交谈时，玛丽按下了录音键。

sentences.en: They discussed the events of the weekend that Louise went missing and speculated as to what might have happened.
sentences.zh: 他们讨论了露易丝失踪那个周末发生的种种事情，并推测可能发生了什么。

sentences.en: A few different scenarios were considered, including that Louise might have been abducted by a stranger.
sentences.zh: 他们考虑了几种不同的假设，包括露易丝可能是被陌生人绑架了。

sentences.en: Perhaps someone had parked their vehicle on the shoulder and feigned car trouble and when Louise pulled over to help, they grabbed her.
sentences.zh: 也许有人把车停在路肩上，假装车子出了故障，当露易丝靠边停车帮忙时，他们就抓走了她。

sentences.en: Brett Morgan eventually told Marie that he had a specific suspect in mind.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·摩根最终告诉玛丽，他心里有一个特定的怀疑对象。

sentences.en: He believed that Louise's ex, John Maisonweuve, was behind her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 他坚信露易丝的前男友约翰·梅森韦夫是她失踪的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: John's cottage wasn't far from the area of River Road where Louise's car was found.
sentences.zh: 约翰的小木屋离发现露易丝汽车的河畔路（River Road）区域不远。

sentences.en: Brett thought the police should be looking at John, but they didn't seem interested.
sentences.zh: 布雷特认为警方应该调查约翰，但他们似乎并不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Over the next few weeks, Marie began conducting her own investigation.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，玛丽开始展开她自己的调查。

sentences.en: She met with Brett Morgan again and spoke with him over the phone a number of times.
sentences.zh: 她再次与布雷特·摩根会面，并与他在电话里交谈过好多次。

sentences.en: But Marie had more difficulty making contact with Louisa's other loved ones.
sentences.zh: 但玛丽在联系露易丝的其他亲友时遇到了更多困难。

sentences.en: Most of Louisa's family and friends wouldn't talk to her.
sentences.zh: 露易丝的大多数家人和朋友都不愿意跟她说话。

sentences.en: After visiting the area where Louisa's jeep had been abandoned,
sentences.zh: 在实地探访了露易丝的吉普车被遗弃的区域后，

sentences.en: Marie began to agree with Brett Morgan that a random attack by a stranger wasn't likely.
sentences.zh: 玛丽开始赞同布雷特·摩根的看法，即陌生人随机袭击的可能性不大。

sentences.en: The jeep had been locked up with all of Louise's things inside.
sentences.zh: 那辆吉普车锁得好好的，露易丝的所有物品都留在车内。

sentences.en: If Louise had only gotten out for a moment to help someone in need or had been dragged out against her will, then why would she have locked the doors?
sentences.zh: 如果露易丝只是下车片刻去帮助需要帮助的人，或者是非自愿地被强行拖走，那她为什么还要锁上车门呢？

sentences.en: Marie kept digging and one month after taking on the case, she had a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 玛丽继续深入挖掘，在接手此案一个月后，她迎来了突破。

sentences.en: She asked Brett Morgan to speak with her so she could update him.
sentences.zh: 她请布雷特·摩根与她见面，以便向他通报最新进展。

sentences.en: On Tuesday June 20, almost two months after Louise went missing, the pair met up again
sentences.zh: 6月20日星期二，在路易丝失踪近两个月后，两人再次见面

sentences.en: Marie explained that she had convinced John Maisonweuve to be interviewed and had noticed a few discrepancies in his version of events
sentences.zh: 玛丽解释说，她已经说服约翰·梅森韦夫接受采访，并注意到他叙述的事情经过中存在一些出入

sentences.en: She had also spoken to a friend of John's who had told her something John had confided in them
sentences.zh: 她还和约翰的一位朋友交谈过，这位朋友告诉她一件约翰曾向其吐露过的秘密

sentences.en: According to this friend, John and Louise had gotten into an argument because John wanted Louise to leave Brett, but she refused
sentences.zh: 据这位朋友透露，约翰和路易丝曾发生过争吵，因为约翰想让路易丝离开布雷特，但她拒绝了

sentences.en: Marie was coming around to Brett's theory that John Maison-Web had killed Louise
sentences.zh: 玛丽开始倾向于布雷特的推测，即约翰·梅森韦布杀害了路易丝

sentences.en: She asked Brett what he thought John would have done with Louise's body
sentences.zh: 她问布雷特觉得约翰会把路易丝的尸体怎么处理

sentences.en: Brett didn't think John would have taken it far
sentences.zh: 布雷特觉得约翰不会把尸体带得太远

sentences.en: Carrying a dead body would be like carrying a sack of potatoes, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，搬运一具尸体就像扛一麻袋马铃薯一样。

sentences.en: Most likely, John would have dragged Louise into some nearby bush, maybe just 50 or 60 feet in from the road.
sentences.zh: 最有可能的是，约翰会把路易丝拖进附近某个灌木丛中，也许就在离路边大约50或60英尺的地方。

sentences.en: Marie suggested that the two of them go searching for Louise together.
sentences.zh: 玛丽提议他们俩一起去找找路易丝。

sentences.en: If they could recover her remains, then John Maison-Web would be charged with murder.
sentences.zh: 如果能找到她的遗体，约翰·梅森韦布就会被指控谋杀。

sentences.en: Four days later, Marie Perrant and Brett Morgan met up near Wakefield at around noon Then headed together towards John Maison Webb's cottage
sentences.zh: 四天后，玛丽·佩朗和布雷特·摩根中午左右在韦克菲尔德附近会面，随后一同前往约翰·梅森·韦布的小屋

sentences.en: They spent five hours searching the nearby woods
sentences.zh: 他们花了五个小时搜寻附近的树林

sentences.en: Driving along dusty country roads And occasionally pulling over to cast their eyes over the brush But they found nothing
sentences.zh: 开车行驶在尘土飞扬的乡间小路上，偶尔把车停下，仔细打量路边的灌木丛，但他们什么也没找到

sentences.en: Undeterred, Marie kept working the case
sentences.zh: 玛丽没有气馁，继续调查这个案子

sentences.en: Soon she had another update
sentences.zh: 不久她又有了新的进展

sentences.en: A few days later, she met up with Brett again at a local restaurant to tell him that John
sentences.zh: 几天后，她再次与布雷特在当地的一家餐馆见面，告诉他约翰

sentences.en: Maison-Webb had taken a polygraph test and failed.
sentences.zh: 梅森-韦布已经接受了测谎仪测试，结果没有通过。

sentences.en: Brett remained adamant that Louisa's body must be somewhere near John's cottage.
sentences.zh: 布雷特依然坚信路易丝的尸体一定在约翰的小屋附近某个地方。

sentences.en: The pair made plans to go out searching again the following day, but their plans fell through at the last minute when Brett left a message saying he couldn't make it.
sentences.zh: 两人计划第二天再去搜寻，但就在最后一刻，布雷特留下一条消息说他去不了，计划因此泡汤了。

sentences.en: He was too distraught at the prospect of finding Louise's body.
sentences.zh: 一想到要找到路易丝的尸体，他就心神不定。

sentences.en: The thought of it had kept him up all night and he hadn't had much sleep.
sentences.zh: 这个想法让他一整夜都没合眼，睡眠严重不足。

sentences.en: The pair arranged to go searching another day, but Brett cancelled those plans as well.
sentences.zh: 两人安排改天再去搜寻，但布雷特随后也取消了这些计划。

sentences.en: Frustrated, Marie told Brett that she was fed up with his lack of cooperation and by the way he was leaving all the work to her.
sentences.zh: 玛丽感到很沮丧，她告诉布雷特，自己受够了他的不合作，以及他把所有工作都甩给她的做法。

sentences.en: Brett apologised and the pair finally met up again at a local restaurant.
sentences.zh: 布雷特道了歉，两人最终又在当地的一家餐馆碰面了。

sentences.en: They sat outside and drank beers while discussing the case.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在室外喝着啤酒，讨论着案情。

sentences.en: Marie told Brett that it was imperative they fined Louise.
sentences.zh: 玛丽告诉布雷特，他们务必要找到路易丝。

sentences.en: The police wouldn't be able to lay charges without a body and any inheritance that Brett was entitled to would be tied up as long as she was only a missing person.
sentences.zh: 如果没有尸体，警方就无法提起指控，而且只要她一天被认定为失踪人员，布雷特应得的任何遗产都会被冻结。

sentences.en: Brett finally acquiesced and said he would go looking with her the following day.
sentences.zh: 布雷特终于妥协了，并表示他第二天会和她一起去寻找。

sentences.en: On Thursday, July 6, 1995, Marie Perrant and Brett Morgan met up in
sentences.zh: 1995年7月6日星期四，玛丽·佩朗和布雷特·摩根在

sentences.en: Wakefield once again.
sentences.zh: 韦克菲尔德再次会面。

sentences.en: They began to search a particular wooded section, with Brett driving
sentences.zh: 他们开始搜寻一片特定的林区，布雷特开车

sentences.en: Marie along various roads throughout the area.
sentences.zh: 载着玛丽穿梭于该地区的各种道路上。

sentences.en: Sometimes he would backtrack over a road he'd just headed down as though he was loSt. At one point he told Marie, I don't have a clue where I am.
sentences.zh: 有时他会倒车折返到刚刚走过的路上，仿佛迷路了一般。有一会儿他告诉玛丽：“我根本不知道自己在哪儿。”

sentences.en: Finally they arrived at Irwin Road, an obscure dead-end dirt road about 10 kilometres west of
sentences.zh: 最终他们来到了欧文路，这是一条偏僻的死胡同土路，位于韦克菲尔德以西约

sentences.en: Wakefield.
sentences.zh: 10公里处。

sentences.en: A dense thicket of trees separated the road from the forest within.
sentences.zh: 一片密集的树丛将这条路与里面的森林隔开。

sentences.en: Brett led Marie through the wooded area, pushing back branches as they walked.
sentences.zh: 布雷特带着玛丽穿过林区，一路上拨开树枝前行。

sentences.en: They exited the tree line and came across a clearing with a pine tree.
sentences.zh: 他们走出了树林边缘，来到一块长有一棵松树的空地上。

sentences.en: Pine needles and dead branches that had fallen from the tree were scattered all over the ground.
sentences.zh: 地上散落着从树上掉下来的松针和枯枝。

sentences.en: Marie noticed something else lying nearby and said, look, there's something over there, Brett.
sentences.zh: 玛丽注意到附近还有别的东西躺着，说道：“看，那边有什么东西，布雷特。”

sentences.en: Clothing was strewn about, including a blue coat, a sweater, and two running shoes.
sentences.zh: 散落各处的衣物包括一件蓝色外套、一件毛衣和两只跑步鞋。

sentences.en: What appeared to be a bone was protruding from the sweater.
sentences.zh: 毛衣里似乎有什么骨头露了出来。

sentences.en: Lying a couple of feet away from the clothing was dark brown human hair,
sentences.zh: 距离衣物几英尺远的地方躺着一头深棕色的人类头发，

sentences.en: and on a mossy patch right by the coat was a human skull.
sentences.zh: 而在紧挨着外套的长满苔藓的地上则有一个人类头骨。

sentences.en: It's Louise, said Brett Morgan, before bursting into tears.
sentences.zh: “是路易丝，”布雷特·摩根说着，放声大哭起来。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后继续。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持档案节目继续为您提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Detective Bob Pulfer had been one of the first Ottawa investigators to review Louise Ellis' missing persons report after Brett Morgan filed it.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·普尔弗侦探是审查路易丝·埃利斯失踪报告的首批渥太华调查人员之一，当时布雷特·摩根刚报了案。

sentences.en: He'd also conducted one of Brett's early interviews and was struck by his polite and cooperative demeanour.
sentences.zh: 他还对布雷特进行过早期的一次问话，当时布雷特礼貌且配合的态度给他留下了深刻印象。

sentences.en: Although Ottawa detectives were intrigued by Brett's criminal history, they held no suspicions at this stage and viewed him only as a witness.
sentences.zh: 尽管渥太华的侦探们对布雷特的犯罪前科很感兴趣，但他们在现阶段并没有怀疑他，只是把他当作证人看待。

sentences.en: On the evening of Friday April 28, five days after Louise was reported missing, Detective Pulfer was following up on some of Brett's statements.
sentences.zh: 4月28日星期五晚上，即路易丝被报失踪五天后，普尔弗侦探正在跟进布雷特的一些供述。

sentences.en: Brett had told investigators that on the last day Louise was seen, he had gone to the bank at around noon to deposit a cheque for Louise in the amount of $3,700.
sentences.zh: 布雷特曾告诉调查人员，在路易丝最后一次被人看到的当天，他大约在中午去了银行，为路易丝存了一张3700美元的支票。

sentences.en: On his way home, he stopped at a 7-Eleven store and used Louise's bank card to withdraw $250 for himself.
sentences.zh: 在回家的路上，他在一家7-Eleven便利店停下，用路易丝的银行卡给自己取了250美元。

sentences.en: Brett arrived home at around 1pm, gave Louise her bank card back and she departed between 1 and 2.
sentences.zh: 布雷特大约下午1点到家，把银行卡还给了路易丝，然后她在1点到2点之间离开了。

sentences.en: However, when Detective Pulver checked Louise's bank records, he found the deposit had been made at 1.32pm and Brett withdrew the $250 at 2.53pm.
sentences.zh: 然而，当普尔弗侦探检查路易丝的银行记录时，他发现存款是在下午1点32分进行的，而布雷特是在下午2点53分取了250美元。

sentences.en: This significant discrepancy was enough to make the detective suspicious.
sentences.zh: 这一重大出入足以让侦探产生怀疑。

sentences.en: He requested Brett be placed under 24-hour surveillance.
sentences.zh: 他请求对布雷特实施24小时监视。

sentences.en: A wiretap issue was ordered and a bug was placed on Brett Morgan's phone.
sentences.zh: 有关部门下达了窃听令，并在布雷特·摩根的电话上安装了窃听器。

sentences.en: The discrepancy in Brett's statement wasn't the only cause for suspicion.
sentences.zh: 布雷特供述中的出入并不是引起怀疑的唯一原因。

sentences.en: Although he presented as a soft-spoken man with a rough past who'd redeemed his ways, the truth was more alarming.
sentences.zh: 尽管他表现得像个说话轻声细语、有着坎坷过去但已经改过自新的人，但真相却更加令人震惊。

sentences.en: Decades earlier, when Brett Morgan was 15 years old, he had gotten into a romantic relationship with a girl one year his senior named Sandra, who became pregnant.
sentences.zh: 几十年前，当布雷特·摩根15岁时，他和一个大他一岁名叫桑德拉的女孩谈恋爱，女孩怀孕了。

sentences.en: Brett had lied to Sandra about his age, telling her he was actually 18 And when she found out the truth, she was deeply disturbed
sentences.zh: 布雷特向桑德拉隐瞒了自己的年龄，说自己其实18岁。当她发现真相时，她深受打击

sentences.en: The relationship soon turned abusive, with Brett hitting, slapping and pushing Sandra
sentences.zh: 这段关系很快变成了虐待，布雷特对桑德拉拳打脚踢、扇耳光并推搡她

sentences.en: The young couple broke up, but Brett begged for a second chance They got married and Sandra gave birth to a boy named Christopher
sentences.zh: 这对年轻情侣分手了，但布雷特苦求给一次机会。他们结了婚，桑德拉生下一个男孩，名叫克里斯托弗

sentences.en: The abuse continued and escalated, with Brett now choking Sandra, dragging her around by her hair and throwing his boots at her.
sentences.zh: 虐待仍在继续并且不断升级，布雷特开始掐桑德拉的脖子、揪着她的头发把她拖来拖去，还拿靴子砸她。

sentences.en: Once again she left him, this time moving back to her hometown.
sentences.zh: 她再次离开了他，这一次搬回了自己的家乡。

sentences.en: She and Brett later reconciled and the cycle of violence continued.
sentences.zh: 她和布雷特后来又复合了，暴力循环仍在继续。

sentences.en: Sandra became pregnant with the couple's second child, but during a fight, Brett repeatedly punched her in the stomach, which led to her losing the baby.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉怀上了两人的第二个孩子，但在一次争吵中，布雷特多次重击她的腹部，导致她流产。

sentences.en: In another argument, Brett smeared his own blood on the walls and told Sandra the only way they would part would be through death.
sentences.zh: 在另一次争吵中，布雷特把自己的血涂抹在墙上，并告诉桑德拉，他们唯一的离别方式只能是死亡。

sentences.en: Eventually, Sandra succeeded in escaping Brett and obtaining a divorce.
sentences.zh: 最终，桑德拉成功逃离了布雷特并获得了离婚。

sentences.en: In 1975, Brett Morgan entered into another relationship with a woman named Christine.
sentences.zh: 1975年，布雷特·摩根与一名叫克里斯蒂娜的女子开始了另一段恋情。

sentences.en: He borrowed huge amounts of money from her with promises to repay it.
sentences.zh: 他以承诺还款为由向她借了巨额资金。

sentences.en: He said he was expecting a huge insurance payout from the death of his daughter He also claimed he was about to inherit a $30,000 property from his recently deceased aunt
sentences.zh: 他说他正期待着从他女儿的死中获得一大笔保险赔付，他还声称他即将从他最近去世的姑姑那里继承一处价值三万美元的房产。

sentences.en: But Christine never got her money back She would later find out Brett had no daughter or aunt
sentences.zh: 但克莉丝汀再也没有拿回她的钱。她后来发现布雷特根本没有女儿或姑姑。

sentences.en: Christine wanted out of the relationship
sentences.zh: 克莉丝汀想要结束这段关系。

sentences.en: One night when they were out for dinner, she told Brett she was leaving him He seemed to accept this, but then when they were driving home, he suddenly stopped the car and said,
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，当他们外出吃晚餐时，她告诉布雷特她要离开他。他似乎接受了这一点，但随后当他们开车回家时，他突然把车停下并说道：

sentences.en: If I can't have you, no one will.
sentences.zh: 如果我得不到你，任何人也休想得到。

sentences.en: Then he grabbed her throat, hit her head against the car window and began strangling her.
sentences.zh: 接着他抓住她的喉咙，把她的头撞向车窗，并开始掐她的脖子。

sentences.en: Christine fought back desperately.
sentences.zh: 克莉丝汀拼命反抗。

sentences.en: Brett told her,
sentences.zh: 布雷特对她说：

sentences.en: You fucking bitch, I'm going to kill you.
sentences.zh: 你这个臭婊子，我要杀了你。

sentences.en: Nobody leaves Brett Morgan.
sentences.zh: 没有人能离开布雷特·摩根。

sentences.en: Christine thought she was going to die
sentences.zh: 克莉丝汀以为自己死定了。

sentences.en: She was aware there was a police cruiser with its lights on up ahead and traffic had formed in a line behind it
sentences.zh: 她意识到前方有一辆亮着警灯的警车，后面还排着长长的车队。

sentences.en: Christine managed to open the passenger door and throw herself out of the vehicle
sentences.zh: 克莉丝汀设法打开副驾驶的车门，把自己扔出了车外。

sentences.en: There was a taxi nearby and she got in
sentences.zh: 附近有一辆出租车，她上了车。

sentences.en: Brett Morgan would later track her down and beg for her forgiveness through tears
sentences.zh: 布雷特·摩根后来找到她，泪流满面地请求她原谅。

sentences.en: But Christine left Canada for Florida and never saw him again.
sentences.zh: 但克莉丝汀离开加拿大去了佛罗里达州，再也没有见过他。

sentences.en: Then there was the case of Gwen Telford, the 21-year-old woman who Brett Morgan had killed in 1978.
sentences.zh: 接下来是格温·特尔福德的案子，这位21岁的女子在1978年被布雷特·摩根杀害。

sentences.en: Gwen had a three-year-old daughter and did sex work to support her child.
sentences.zh: 格温有一个三岁的女儿，靠做性工作来养活孩子。

sentences.en: She was good friends with Brett Morgan's latest girlfriend, though Brett himself disliked Gwen and often made derogatory remarks about her.
sentences.zh: 她和布雷特·摩根的最新女友是好朋友，不过布雷特本人很讨厌格温，经常对她恶语相加。

sentences.en: The three had lived together in shared accommodation until Gwen moved out in late October of that year She began staying in a hotel while looking for something more permanent
sentences.zh: 这三个人曾合租过一套房子，直到那年10月下旬格温搬出去。她在寻找更长期住所的同时开始住在一家酒店里。

sentences.en: At around 2.30am on Friday November 3, Brett and a 17-year-old girl went back to Gwen's hotel room with her
sentences.zh: 在11月3日星期五凌晨2点30分左右，布雷特和一个17岁的女孩跟着格温一起回到了她的酒店房间。

sentences.en: The three sat around for about an hour, drinking a bottle of wine
sentences.zh: 三个人坐着喝了一瓶葡萄酒，大约待了一个小时。

sentences.en: Then Brett suddenly stole money from Gwen's purse and ordered her to undress She did
sentences.zh: 然后布雷特突然偷了格温钱包里的钱，并命令她脱衣服。她照做了。

sentences.en: Brett told the 17-year-old to go into the bathroom or he would kill her also
sentences.zh: 布雷特告诉那个17岁的女孩去浴室，否则他连她一起杀掉。

sentences.en: He bound Gwen's hands behind her back with a pair of pantyhose Then shoved her down on the bed
sentences.zh: 他用一条连裤袜把格温的双手反绑在身后，然后把她推倒在床上。

sentences.en: Brett then jumped on Gwen's chest and began choking her with his hands, stating
sentences.zh: 接着，布雷特扑到格温胸前，用双手开始掐她，并说道：

sentences.en: die you bitch, die.
sentences.zh: 去死吧你这个婊子，去死吧。

sentences.en: The 17-year-old heard the killing from the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 那个17岁的女孩在浴室里听到了杀戮的过程。

sentences.en: After Gwen was dead, Brett left the hotel with the 17-year-old and dropped her off at home.
sentences.zh: 格温死后，布雷特和那个17岁的女孩离开酒店，把她送回家中。

sentences.en: Gwen's body was found later that day by hotel cleaning staff.
sentences.zh: 格温的尸体在当天晚些时候被酒店清洁人员发现。

sentences.en: When the police began investigating her murder, Brett helped them with the investigation.
sentences.zh: 当警方开始调查她的谋杀案时，布雷特协助了他们的调查。

sentences.en: Eventually, he was charged with and convicted of first-degree murder But after it was found that the presiding judge had mischarged the jury, a second trial was held
sentences.zh: 最终，他被指控并被判犯有一级谋杀罪。但在发现主审法官对陪审团进行了错误指引后，进行了第二次审判。

sentences.en: This time, Brett was instead found guilty of the lesser charge of manslaughter And sentenced to ten years
sentences.zh: 这一次，布雷特被改判犯有较轻的过失杀人罪，并被判处十年监禁。

sentences.en: When Louise Ellis met Brett Morgan more than a decade later, she didn't know the full extent of his violent history
sentences.zh: 当路易丝·埃利斯在十多年后遇到布雷特·摩根时，她并不知道他暴力历史的全部真相。

sentences.en: Instead, she was left struck by his courage in coming forward to testify for a wrongly incarcerated man.
sentences.zh: 相反，他挺身而出为一个被冤枉入狱的人作证的勇气深深打动了她。

sentences.en: Louise later described their first encounter in her diary, writing,
sentences.zh: 路易丝后来在日记中描述了他们的初次相遇，写道：

sentences.en: That morning he insinuated himself into my life irrevocably.
sentences.zh: 那天早晨，他不可磨灭地闯入了我的生活。

sentences.en: His words were carefully chosen, his voice resonant.
sentences.zh: 他的字斟句酌，他的声音浑厚。

sentences.en: I couldn't help but wonder what a nice guy like that was doing in a place like prison.
sentences.zh: 我不禁想知道，像这样好的人怎么会身陷监狱这种地方。

sentences.en: Louise was a passionate and highly intelligent woman with strongly held convictions about right and wrong.
sentences.zh: 路易丝是一个充满激情且极其聪明的女性，对对与错有着坚定的信念。

sentences.en: She'd struggled with romantic relationships in the past, finding them hard to sustain when the early honeymoon phase gave way to the ordinary nature of everyday life.
sentences.zh: 她过去在恋爱关系中历经坎坷，发现当最初的热恋期让位于平淡的日常生活时，感情很难维持。

sentences.en: In Bratt Morgan, she saw someone with whom she could have the all-consuming love she so desired.
sentences.zh: 在布雷特·摩根身上，她看到了一种可以让她拥有梦寐以求的炽热之爱的人。

sentences.en: She was attracted to what she saw as his honesty and simplicity.
sentences.zh: 她被她所看到的他的诚实和朴素所吸引。

sentences.en: His working-class background was very different to her middle-class one, but it was a case of opposites attracting.
sentences.zh: 他的工人阶级背景与她的中产阶级背景截然不同，但这正是异性相吸的一个例子。

sentences.en: Above all, Louise appreciated how safe and loved Brett made her feel.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，路易丝感激布雷特带给她的安全感和爱意。

sentences.en: Initially, from the outside, they appeared to be a happy couple.
sentences.zh: 起初，从外表上看，他们似乎是一对幸福的情侣。

sentences.en: Yet, cracks started to appear even before Brett was released from prison.
sentences.zh: 然而，甚至在布雷特出狱之前，裂痕就已经开始出现。

sentences.en: The couple swung between euphoric highs and painful lows.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣在极乐的高潮和痛苦的低谷之间摇摆不定。

sentences.en: They had screaming arguments over the phone, which left Louise drained and despondent.
sentences.zh: 他们在电话里大吵大叫，这让路易丝精疲力竭、沮丧灰心。

sentences.en: She never told her family members that her new partner had been convicted of manslaughter, instead telling them only that he'd committed fraud.
sentences.zh: 她从未告诉家人她的新伴侣曾被判犯有过失杀人罪，只告诉他们他犯了诈骗罪。

sentences.en: After Brett was released from prison, the things that had initially attracted Louise to him began to repel her.
sentences.zh: 布雷特出狱后，当初吸引路易丝的那些特质开始让她感到反感。

sentences.en: She found his tastes crude and realised how different their values and opinions were.
sentences.zh: 她发现他的品味粗俗，并意识到他们的价值观和观点有多么不同。

sentences.en: While Louise was an intellectual who loved to read and debate ideas, Brett didn't have an inquisitive mind at all.
sentences.zh: 路易丝是一个热爱阅读和探讨思想的知识分子，而布雷特则完全没有求知欲。

sentences.en: Within two months of moving in with Louise, Brett was already physically assaulting her.
sentences.zh: 在搬去和路易丝同居后不到两个月，布雷特就已经开始对她实施身体暴力了。

sentences.en: She wrote in her diary that he had shoved her, gripped her arm, poured beer over her head, pushed her down on the bed and refused to let her up and punched a hole in the wall.
sentences.zh: 她在日记中写道，他曾推搡她、抓她的胳膊、把啤酒倒在她头上、把她推倒在床上并拒绝让她起来、还在墙上砸了一个洞。

sentences.en: He also made verbal threats.
sentences.zh: 他还进行言语威胁。

sentences.en: A tenant who resided on the upper level of Louise's home sometimes heard screaming coming from downstairs.
sentences.zh: 住在路易丝家楼上的租客有时会听到楼下传来尖叫声。

sentences.en: Louise became overwhelmed by despair and self-loathing and wrote notes to herself on how she could be a better partner.
sentences.zh: 路易丝被绝望和自我厌恶所吞噬，给自己写便条，思考如何才能成为一个更好的伴侣。

sentences.en: These low points were punctuated by brief windows of joy, honeymoon phases where Brett would be affectionate and loving.
sentences.zh: 这些低谷期穿插着短暂的快乐窗口，那是布雷特会表现得温情脉脉的热恋期。

sentences.en: One day, Louise wrote in her diary,
sentences.zh: 有一天，路易丝在日记中写道：

sentences.en: I love going places with Brett.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和布雷特一起去各个地方。

sentences.en: He's keen, he's beautiful to be seen with, he's friendly.
sentences.zh: 他热情，带出去很有面子，而且很友好。

sentences.en: The next day, she described an argument they had where Brett pinned her down and was frothing at the mouth.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她描述了他们的一次争吵，当时布雷特把她按倒在地，口吐白沫。

sentences.en: This relationship is either going to kill me or cure me, Louise wrote.
sentences.zh: 这段感情要么会要了我的命，要么会治愈我，路易丝写道。

sentences.en: The month before Louise went missing, she went to the hospital for x-rays after suffering a blow to her sternum.
sentences.zh: 在路易丝失踪前的一个月，她因胸骨受到重击而去医院拍了X光。

sentences.en: She told a number of friends and acquaintances that Brett was responsible.
sentences.zh: 她向许多朋友和熟人透露是布雷特干的。

sentences.en: As well as learning about Brett Morgan's physical abuse of Louise, detectives discovered that he'd also taken advantage of her financially.
sentences.zh: 除了了解到布雷特·摩根对路易丝实施身体虐待之外，侦探们还发现他在经济上也利用了她。

sentences.en: Louise had always been very responsible with money and was a good saver.
sentences.zh: 路易丝对金钱一直非常负责，是个很会存钱的人。

sentences.en: She supported Brett by buying him clothes, food, and letting him move in with her.
sentences.zh: 她给布雷特买衣服、买食物并让他搬进家里来支持他。

sentences.en: She also purchased a truck and tools for him as part of a home renovation business they started together named Morales, a portmanteau of their two surnames.
sentences.zh: 她还为他买了一辆卡车和工具，用于他们共同创办的一家名为莫拉莱斯（Morales，取两人姓氏的混成词）的房屋装修公司。

sentences.en: But the business never took off and the brand new truck disappeared.
sentences.zh: 但这家公司从未起色，那辆崭新的卡车也消失了。

sentences.en: Brett would say it had been taken by a biker gang that was shaking him down.
sentences.zh: 布雷特声称卡车是被一个勒索他的飞车党抢走了。

sentences.en: The gang was supposedly extorting Brett as revenge for his testimony against his former cellmate, Larry Fisher.
sentences.zh: 这个帮派据说是为了报复他指证前狱友拉里·费舍尔而对布雷特进行敲诈。

sentences.en: Louise complained to friends that Brett would take her bank cards without asking and withdraw cash.
sentences.zh: 路易丝向朋友抱怨，布雷特会不打招呼就拿走她的银行卡并提取现金。

sentences.en: He rapidly drained her bank account and ran up her credit card debt.
sentences.zh: 他迅速掏空了她的银行账户，并刷爆了她的信用卡债务。

sentences.en: Four months before Louise vanished, Brett forged a cheque on her personal line of credit for $7,000.
sentences.zh: 在路易丝失踪四个月前，布雷特伪造了一张她7000美元的个人信用额度支票。

sentences.en: The next month he forged another for $5,400
sentences.zh: 次月他又伪造了一张5400美元的支票。

sentences.en: When Louise discovered Brett was stealing from her he claimed he needed the money to pay off the biker gang
sentences.zh: 当路易丝发现布雷特在偷她的钱时，他声称他需要这笔钱来还给飞车党。

sentences.en: Brett didn't just steal from Louise he targeted her loved ones too
sentences.zh: 布雷特不仅偷路易丝的钱，他还把目标对准了她所爱的人。

sentences.en: On one occasion, Brett helped out Louise's father by performing some repairs on his bathroom
sentences.zh: 有一次，布雷特帮路易丝的父亲修理了浴室。

sentences.en: After Brett left, Louise's father discovered that one of his credit cards was missing.
sentences.zh: 布雷特离开后，路易丝的父亲发现自己的一张信用卡不见了。

sentences.en: It would later be traced back to friends of Brett's who used it in a shopping spree.
sentences.zh: 这后来被追查到布雷特的朋友身上，他们用这张卡疯狂购物。

sentences.en: Brett's abuse and stealing took a toll on the relationship and in December 1994, Louise asked him to move out.
sentences.zh: 布雷特的虐待和偷窃对这段关系造成了沉重打击，1994年12月，路易丝要求他搬出去。

sentences.en: The following month, he moved into his own basement apartment, but he was told to leave in February after someone broke into the landlord's home upstairs.
sentences.zh: 次月，他搬进了自己的地下室公寓，但在2月由于楼上房东家遭人闯入而被勒令离开。

sentences.en: Louise took him back.
sentences.zh: 路易丝重新接纳了他。

sentences.en: They agreed it would be a temporary fix, with Brett moving out again on May 1.
sentences.zh: 他们同意这只是权宜之计，布雷特将在5月1日再次搬走。

sentences.en: He had told investigators that their decision to live separately didn't mean their relationship was in trouble.
sentences.zh: 他曾告诉调查人员，他们分居的决定并不意味着他们的关系出了问题。

sentences.en: By April 1995, Brett owed Louise more than $23,000.
sentences.zh: 到1995年4月，布雷特欠路易丝的钱超过了23,000美元。

sentences.en: He said he would pay her back as soon as a friend from Toronto named Bob lent him the money.
sentences.zh: 他说，只要多伦多一个名叫鲍勃的朋友把钱借给他，他就会还钱。

sentences.en: Bob was apparently going to wire Brett the money by mid-April and Brett would then transfer it to her.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃显然打算在4月中旬通过电汇将钱汇给布雷特，然后布雷特再转交给她。

sentences.en: Louise was extremely anxious to receive the funds, telling Franz she was down to her last
sentences.zh: 路易丝极其焦急地想要收到这笔款项，她告诉弗兰兹说她只剩下
200美元了。

sentences.en: She also told them that her relationship with Brett was over, whether he paid her back or not.
sentences.zh: 她还告诉他们，无论布雷特还钱与否，她和他的关系都彻底结束了。

sentences.en: She was sick of him controlling and using her.
sentences.zh: 她受够了他的控制和利用。

sentences.en: On Friday April 21, the day before Louise went missing, she called her bank at least twice to check whether a bank transfer had come through.
sentences.zh: 在4月21日星期五，也就是路易丝失踪的前一天，她至少两次打电话给银行，查询电汇是否到账。

sentences.en: It hadn't.
sentences.zh: 钱并没有到账。

sentences.en: After police began bugging Brett Morgan's phone, they soon intercepted regular calls he was having with a Scottish woman named Marie Perrant.
sentences.zh: 在警方开始对布雷特·摩根的电话进行窃听后，他们很快截获了他与一名叫玛丽·佩朗特的苏格兰女性之间的例行通话。

sentences.en: On Tuesday June 15, about a month into Marie's contact with Brett, an Ottawa detective contacted her to ask how she knew
sentences.zh: 6月15日星期二，在玛丽与布雷特接触大约一个月后，一名渥太华侦探联系了她，询问她是如何认识

sentences.en: Brett Morgan.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·摩根的。

sentences.en: Marie explained that she was an aspiring private investigator who had been working with Brett.
sentences.zh: 玛丽解释说，她是一位立志成为私家侦探的人，一直在与布雷特合作。

sentences.en: Although she'd initially reached out to him due to sympathy, the truth was she'd been experiencing certain doubts ever since their second meeting.
sentences.zh: 尽管她最初出于同情而接近他，但事实是，自从他们的第二次见面以来，她心里一直产生某些怀疑。

sentences.en: While listening over her tape recording of that conversation, Marie had noticed something strange.
sentences.zh: 在反复聆听那次对话的录音时，玛丽注意到了一些奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: They had been discussing Louise's car and the way it was found.
sentences.zh: 他们当时在讨论路易丝的车以及它是如何被发现的。

sentences.en: Marie asked Brett whether the driver's seat was still in the same position it would have been if Louise was the last to drive it.
sentences.zh: 玛丽问布雷特，驾驶座的位置是否仍然和如果由路易丝最后驾驶时保持的一样。

sentences.en: If it had been pushed back, that might indicate a taller man had left the car there.
sentences.zh: 如果座位被往后调了，那可能表明是一个个子更高的男人把车停在那里的。

sentences.en: Brett replied,
sentences.zh: 布雷特回答说：

sentences.en: Exactly the way I left.
sentences.zh: 完全就是我离开时的样子。

sentences.en: Then he abruptly stopped, as though catching himself, and changed his answer to exactly the way Louise left it.
sentences.zh: 然后他突然停住，仿佛意识到了什么，改口回答说完全是路易丝离开时的样子。

sentences.en: On reflection, this struck Marie as suspicious.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，这让玛丽觉得很可疑。

sentences.en: She'd also noticed other things.
sentences.zh: 她还注意到了其他一些事情。

sentences.en: Most of Louise's clothing and jewellery had gone, as though she wasn't expected to return.
sentences.zh: 路易丝的大部分衣服和珠宝都不见了，就好像她没打算回来一样。

sentences.en: Nor were there any women's toiletries in the home's bathroom.
sentences.zh: 家里浴室里也没有任何女性洗漱用品。

sentences.en: When Louise's loved ones found out that Marie was working with Brett Morgan, none of them would speak to her.
sentences.zh: 当路易丝的亲友们发现玛丽在和布雷特·摩根合作时，没有一个人愿意跟她说话。

sentences.en: They were all convinced that he was behind her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 他们都确信布雷特是她失踪的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: Detectives Bob Pulfer and John Savage asked Marie if she would visit the police station and bring her taped interviews with her.
sentences.zh: 侦探鲍勃·普尔弗和约翰·萨维奇问玛丽是否愿意去警察局并带上她录下的采访记录。

sentences.en: She agreed.
sentences.zh: 她同意了。

sentences.en: During their meeting, Detective Bob
sentences.zh: 在他们会面期间，侦探鲍勃

sentences.en: Pulfer asked Marie what she thought had happened to Louise.
sentences.zh: 普尔弗问玛丽她认为路易丝遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: She told him that she thought Brett
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，她认为布雷特

sentences.en: Morgan had murdered her.
sentences.zh: 摩根谋杀了她。

sentences.en: This was the detective's belief as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是这位侦探的看法。

sentences.en: They asked Marie whether she would be willing to go undercover for them.
sentences.zh: 他们问玛丽是否愿意为他们担任卧底。

sentences.en: When Marie asked what they would need her to do,
sentences.zh: 当玛丽问他们需要她做什么时，

sentences.en: Detective Pulfer replied, perhaps you could find out what Brett Morgan knows about the disappearance of Louise Ellis.
sentences.zh: 普尔弗侦探回答说，也许你可以查出布雷特·摩根对路易丝·埃利斯的失踪了解多少。

sentences.en: Marie agreed to help and Detective Savage looked at her, then jokingly said, well, maybe you could find the body too.
sentences.zh: 玛丽同意帮忙，萨维奇侦探看着她，然后半开玩笑地说，好吧，也许你也能顺便找到尸体。

sentences.en: From that point on, Marie Perrant was a double agent.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，玛丽·佩朗特成了一名双重间谍。

sentences.en: At the police's request, she lied to Brett Morgan, telling him that she'd interviewed Louise's ex,
sentences.zh: 应警方要求，她对布雷特·摩根撒谎，告诉他她采访过路易丝的前男友

sentences.en: John Maisonweff, and there were discrepancies in his story.
sentences.zh: 约翰·梅松韦夫，并且他的供词中存在矛盾之处。

sentences.en: She also claimed that a friend of
sentences.zh: 她还声称

sentences.en: John's told her about an argument between him and Louise.
sentences.zh: 约翰的一个朋友向她透露了他和路易丝之间的一次争吵。

sentences.en: Brett had appeared stunned when she shared this information.
sentences.zh: 当她分享这些信息时，布雷特显得惊呆了。

sentences.en: Marie said that if they wanted John convicted of Louise's murder, then they needed to find Louise's remains.
sentences.zh: 玛丽说，如果他们想让约翰因谋杀路易丝而被定罪，那么他们就需要找到路易丝的遗体。

sentences.en: She encouraged Brett to think of where Louise might be, telling him with her perseverance and his criminal mind, they should find the body.
sentences.zh: 她鼓励布雷特想想路易丝可能在哪里，并告诉他凭借她的毅力和他的犯罪头脑，他们一定能找到尸体。

sentences.en: Brett was quick to speculate where Louise might be But he also seemed to harbour some suspicions about Marie
sentences.zh: 布雷特很快就开始猜测路易丝可能在哪里，但他也似乎对玛丽怀有一丝疑心。

sentences.en: He began making references to undercover cops And told Marie that when a friend came to visit him
sentences.zh: 他开始暗示卧底警察的存在，并告诉玛丽，当一个朋友来探望他时，

sentences.en: Brett had insisted on patting him down to check for hidden listening devices
sentences.zh: 布雷特坚持要搜身检查是否有隐藏的窃听装置。

sentences.en: Marie asked him if he thought she was an undercover cop He laughed and said no
sentences.zh: 玛丽问他是否认为她是卧底警察，他笑着说没有。

sentences.en: During their first search for Louise's remains, Brett pulled out a bandana and, without saying a word, wrapped it around Marie's neck.
sentences.zh: 在他们首次寻找路易丝遗体的过程中，布雷特掏出一块头巾，一言不发地把它缠在玛丽的脖子上。

sentences.en: This scared her, as he had already told her how he had previously strangled a woman, so she pushed his hands away.
sentences.zh: 这吓坏了她，因为他之前已经告诉过她他是如何勒死一个女人的，于是她推开了他的手。

sentences.en: Brett told her it was just a gift to keep her cool during the search.
sentences.zh: 布雷特告诉她这只是一件在搜寻时用来防暑降温的礼物。

sentences.en: As they looked, a police helicopter hovered nearby.
sentences.zh: 正当他们寻找时，一架警用直升机在附近盘旋。

sentences.en: This clearly made Brett anxious and his search was lackluster He looked like someone taking a casual walk through the woods instead of searching for a body
sentences.zh: 这显然让布雷特感到焦虑，他的搜寻也敷衍了事。他看起来就像是在树林里随便散步，而不是在寻找尸体。

sentences.en: Marie told detectives how the helicopter had spooked Brett and they didn't dispatch it again
sentences.zh: 玛丽把直升机如何吓到布雷特的情况告诉了侦探们，于是他们没有再派直升机。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Brett appeared reluctant to search again after that, cancelling plans a couple of times
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，布雷特在那之后似乎很不情愿再次搜寻，曾几次取消计划。

sentences.en: Marie became more insistent and the two eventually met up at a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 玛丽变得更加坚持，两人最终在一家餐厅见面。

sentences.en: Brett admitted he sometimes wondered if Marie was an undercover officer, telling her she was either that or a great actress.
sentences.zh: 布雷特承认他有时会怀疑玛丽是否是卧底警察，并告诉她要么她是卧底，要么就是个绝佳的演员。

sentences.en: Well, I'm not, Marie replied.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不是，玛丽回答道。

sentences.en: Brett began to hit on Marie, making suggestive remarks about her appearance and kissing her.
sentences.zh: 布雷特开始对玛丽调情，对她的外表做出暗示性的评论并亲吻她。

sentences.en: She felt like throwing up, but instead kissed him back, terrified that if she didn't, her cover would be blown.
sentences.zh: 她感到一阵恶心，但还是回吻了他，生怕如果不这么做，她的卧底身份就会暴露。

sentences.en: This seemed to convince him and the pair made plans to search again the following day of

sentences.en: Because of Brett's criminal background, he knew he needed to deflect attention to another suspect.
sentences.zh: 由于布雷特的犯罪背景，他知道自己需要将注意力转移到另一个嫌疑人身上。

sentences.en: Then he had abandoned Louise's vehicle in a secondary location that was also near John's property before cycling home on a bike he'd stashed in the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 然后，他将露易丝的车丢弃在另一个同样靠近约翰房产的地点，接着骑着藏在车里的一辆自行车回了家。

sentences.en: Brett's seemingly cooperative demeanour and public pleas to the press were further attempts to appear innocent.

sentences.zh: 她倾其所有，试图协助你重新融入社会。
